brand.name: ARTFUL
brand.identity: ARTFUL is a high-end international D2C artistic lifestyle and thoughtful-gifting brand. It combines bespoke craftsmanship with emotional storytelling, creating heirloom-quality objects and curated gift boxes.

interface_duality_principle.storefront: Feels like an editorial museum gallery and luxury boutique. Warm, editorial, image-led, generous whitespace, serif titles, serene interactions, high perceived value.
interface_duality_principle.admin_panel: Feels like a high-precision commerce flight deck. Dense, clean, operational, structured, dark/slate sidebar, cardless high-density tables, instant filters, data-first.

font_family.body_and_ui: Plus Jakarta Sans, General Sans, sans-serif

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal text-primary tracking-tight
scale.caption: text-xs font-sans font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-muted

layout_and_spacing.whitespace: Generous (2x to 3x normal density for Storefront). Use py-16, py-24, py-32 for section separation.
layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: Asymmetric editorial grids with ratio spans (e.g. col-span-12 md:col-span-8 and col-span-12 md:col-span-4).
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px subtle solid strokes (#E6DDD9) without aggressive dropshadows.

announcement_bar.description: Top-level sticky bar in deep plum (#5C3243) with soft gold (#E9D8A6) typography.
announcement_bar.content: Complimentary Handwritten Gift Card & Bespoke Artisanal Packaging on Orders above ₹2,999

header_nav.type: Glassmorphic floating or sticky bar with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).
elements: Brand Logo (ARTFUL wordmark in serif plum)
Desktop Links: Curated Gifts, Occasions, Bespoke Boxes, Artisanal Decor, Our Story
Utility Icons: Smart Search Trigger, Wishlist Counter, Cart Drawer Trigger (with item count pill)

hero_section.type: Split-screen or layered editorial scene with 40% height ratio image focus.
hero_section.heading: Artisanal Curations for Unforgettable Moments
hero_section.subheading: Handcrafted lifestyle objects and bespoke gift boxes thoughtfully created to elevate life's gentle celebrations.

bestsellers.type: Asymmetric product card carousel or 4-column grid with quick-view and instant gift add.

gift_by_occasion_or_recipient.type: Interactive tabs / pills filtering occasions (Anniversary, Housewarming, Birthday, Corporate, Weddings) and recipients (For Her, For Him, For Couples).

brand_story.type: Editorial vignette featuring artisan spotlight, sustainability commitment, and custom calligraphy gift cards.

testimonials.type: Customer quotes with verified buyer badge, ratings, and luxury gift unboxing preview photos.

newsletter.type: Minimalist subscription box with email input, INR 500 first-gift coupon promise, and privacy note.

footer.type: Deep wine/plum section with customer care, INR currency badge, gift guide links, social media, and copyright.

catalog_grid.layout: 3 or 4 column grid with hover image switch (lifestyle placement vs product close-up).
catalog_grid.filters: Drawer or collapsible sidebar for Price in ₹, Occasion, Material, Recipient, Delivery Speed.
catalog_grid.sorting: Sort by Featured, Price: Low to High, Price: High to Low, New Arrivals.

pdp.gallery: Interactive image gallery with zoom capability and thumbnail navigation.
pdp.pricing: Displayed in ₹ INR with tax inclusion note.
pdp.gifting_customizer: Gift wrap checkbox (₹199), handwritten message input card (max 250 chars), preferred delivery date selector.

cart_drawer.type: Slide-over right panel with progress bar toward free gift wrapping (₹2,999 threshold).

steps: Step 1: Mobile Number & OTP Verification (for friction-free Indian D2C flow)
Step 2: Shipping & Recipient Address (Support distinct Gift Recipient Address vs Billing Address)
Step 4: Payment (UPI / Razorpay simulation, Credit/Debit Cards, COD with ₹99 fee)

admin_panel_specifications.density: High data-density tables with subtle grid borders, inline search, date range picker, export CSV, bulk actions.
admin_panel_specifications.status_chips: Pill-shaped badges with soft tinted background and crisp text.
admin_panel_specifications.forms: Structured 2-column forms with input validation feedback, monetary ₹ inputs, and image drag-and-drop upload zone.

curated_media_assets.description: Warm sunlight ceramic vase on woven tablecloth.
Uniquely shaped ceramic vase on dark backdrop.
Luxury gift box with ribbon and dried roses.
Mint green luxury gift box with twine and roses.

testing_attributes_policy.rule: All buttons, form inputs, links, tabs, tables, status indicators, and modal triggers MUST contain explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

file_system_note: Target application is implemented using React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components. Ensure guidelines and imports reflect standard .js syntax.
